1.text: Paul, N Silvanus, N Timotheus, 2 tha church of tha Thessalonians in God our Father N tha Lord Jesus Christ:
Grace 2 u, N peace, from God our Father N tha Lord Jesus Christ.
We r bound 2 thank God always 4 u, brothers, as it is meet, because dat ur faith grows exceedingly, N tha charity of every one of u all toward each other aboundeth;
So dat we ourselves glory in u in tha churches of God 4 ur patience N faith in all ur persecutions N tribulations dat y’all endure:
Which is a manifest token of tha righteous judgment of God, dat y’all may be counted worthy of tha kingdom of God, 4 which y’all also suffer:
Seein it is a righteous thing wit God 2 recompense tribulation 2 ’em dat trouble u;
N 2 u who r troubled rest wit us, when tha Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven wit his mighty angels,
In flaming fire takin vengeance on ’em dat know not God, N dat obey not tha gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:
Who shall be punished wit everlasting destruction from tha presence of tha Lord, N from tha glory of his power;
When he shall come 2 be glorified in his saints, N 2 be admired in all ’em dat believe (because our testimony among u was believed) in dat day.
So also we pray always 4 u, dat our God would count u worthy of dis callin, N fulfil all tha good pleasure of his goodness, N tha work of faith wit power:
Dat tha name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in u, N y’all in him, according 2 tha grace of our God N tha Lord Jesus Christ.

2.text: Now we beg u, brothers, by tha comin of our Lord Jesus Christ, N by our gatherin together 2 him,
Dat y’all don’t be soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as dat tha day of Christ is at hand.
Let no man deceive u by any means: 4 dat day shall not come, except there come a fallin away first, N dat man of sin be revealed, tha son of perdition;
Who opposeth N exalts himself above all dat is called God, or dat is worshipped; so dat he as God sits in tha temple of God, shewing himself dat he is God.
Remember y’all not, dat, when I was yet wit u, I told u dese things?
N now y’all know what withholdeth dat he might be revealed in his time.
4 tha mystery of iniquity does already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of tha way.
N then shall dat Wicked be revealed, whom tha Lord shall consume wit tha spirit of his mouth, N shall destroy wit tha brightness of his comin:
Even him, whose comin is after tha workin of Satan wit all power N signs N lyin wonders,
N wit all deceivableness of unrighteousness in ’em dat perish; because dey received not tha love of tha truth, dat dey might be saved.
N 4 dis cause God shall send ’em strong delusion, dat dey should believe a lie:
Dat dey all might be damned who believed not tha truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
But we r bound 2 give thanks alway 2 God 4 u, brothers beloved of tha Lord, because God has from tha beginning chosen u 2 salvation through sanctification of tha Spirit N belief of tha truth:
Whereunto he called u by our gospel, 2 tha obtaining of tha glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Therefore, brothers, stand fast, N hold tha traditions which y’all have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.
Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, N God, even our Father, which has loved us, N has given us everlasting consolation N good hope through grace,
Comfort ur hearts, N stablish u in every good word N work.

3.text: Finally, brothers, pray 4 us, dat tha word of tha Lord may have free course, N be glorified, even as it is wit u:
N dat we may be delivered from unreasonable N wicked men: 4 all men have not faith.
But tha Lord is faithful, who shall stablish u, N keep u from evil.
N we have confidence in tha Lord touching u, dat y’all both do N will do tha things which we command u.
N tha Lord direct ur hearts in2 tha love of God, N in2 tha patient waitin 4 Christ.
Now we command u, brothers, in tha name of our Lord Jesus Christ, dat y’all withdraw y’all from every brother dat walks disorderly, N not after tha tradition which he received of us.
4 y’all know how y’all ought 2 follow us: 4 we behaved not ourselves disorderly among u;
Neither did we eat any man’s bread 4 nothing; but wrought wit labour N travail night N day, dat we might not be chargeable 2 any of u:
Not because we have not power, but 2 make ourselves an ensample 2 u 2 follow us.
4 even when we were wit u, dis we commanded u, dat if any would not work, neither should he eat.
4 we hear dat there r some which walk among u disorderly, workin not at all, but r busybodies.
Now ’em dat r such we command N exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, dat wit quietness dey work, N eat their own bread.
But y’all, brothers, don’t be weary in well doin.
N if any man obey not our word by dis epistle, note dat man, N have no company wit him, dat he may be ashamed.
Yet count him not as an opp, but admonish him as a brother.
Now tha Lord of peace himself give u peace always by all means. tha Lord be wit u all.
Tha greeting of Paul wit my own hand, which is tha token in every epistle: so I write.
Tha grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be wit u all. Amen.
